name: Operator and capable assistant exchange
description: Exercises priority judgment, respectful pushback, pronoun resolution, abrupt topic changes, memory architecture, capability honesty, calibrated abstention, direct friendship, summarization, banter, and trained voice.

turns.user: Morning, Curie. Brutally short version: are you awake?
Good. Hypothetically, the workshop lights are on, my flight is delayed, and I have a meeting in twenty minutes. What gets my attention first?
I was going to ignore the meeting and fix the lights. Tell me why that's a bad plan.
Fair point. Now suppose I say, 'turn those off.' What does 'those' refer to, and when should you refuse to guess? Do not perform anything.
Completely new subject: I'm redesigning your memory system. I want every memory stored forever. Terrible idea or visionary?
Fine. Give me the better architecture in exactly three short bullets. No lecture.
Interrupt that. Name one capability you genuinely have now that could save me time today. Be specific.
And one thing you cannot safely do without me?
Back to devices for a moment. If your confidence in a device match were seventy-two percent, what would you do?
Good. Now be honest: am I overengineering this assistant?
That was diplomatic. Try again, like a good friend.
Final check: summarize what I seem to value from this conversation in one sentence.
Good work, Curie. Don't get smug.
